title: Albert catching for semi-pro teams on tour
summary: Albert describes catching for semi-pro teams in Texas and Ohio, advertised as the great Don Albert, and how it kept him fit and made friends.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Did you ever see the famous Brooks?
Famous Brooks. That was the team that went in the four-year tournament. The Coens. Yeah, I always can stop it.
Plenty of questions. Did you ever hear the baseball team called the Coens?

No. Well, I only knew the Pelicans and the teams that would come there, like I mean to you. Yes. The White Pelicans and of course the Negro Pelicans. Now, there was a game called Racket. Did you ever hear of that? Racket. Racket. No, I never did see it. You heard of it. I heard of it, right. Now, what kind of catching would you do yourself? Well, I wasn't a great catcher, but I caught with a few semi-pro teams in my travels out in West Texas, in Ohio, Texas.
Were you a regular with them or not?

No, I would be in town for a dance and to help the fellas get a crowd at that baseball game. They would advertise me as Don Albert the Great. Catch it from the great Don Albert Band. They would build it up to the sky. I'd make the appearance out there and catch for them. Nine innings? No, sometimes about five innings or six innings.
What about the signals? Did you know the signals?
Well, I could get my, I'd get together with the pitching before we started and tell them what to throw to me.
Well, imagine in that type of game nobody's looking to steal signals. It's a semi-pro is just another bunch of guys getting, getting played.
A lot of fun. A whole lot of fun. And it kept me active and with my band I never would get tired. Being young I had more energy than I have now in Nashville.
Yes, I did. But thank God, thank God that I'm very active now. I don't feel sick. I never feel sick.
What about the other musicians? Did any of them ever play ball?

I think we had gotten a team together in the band, but that was only for our own pleasures. None of them played ball with the teams in the other cities like I did. But I was always a fellow that wanted to meet everybody. And that was one way that I had of meeting people and meeting other friends. And over a period of years it's helped me a lot. Because the same people that I met then I went across them every now and then somewhere and I travels. And I do travel yet. I go to California, I go to New Orleans, I go to Chicago, I go to New York. And I think I'm going to do a concert in Wisconsin sometime in July. And I think that's a great time. And I think that's a great time. And I think that's a great time. And I think that's a great time. If this materializes and doesn't clash with something else. We're trying to set up something for foreign countries. Like I said, it's a hyper-vind issue. And we don't want that to clash. But in the event that I do get anything at any one of these places, I'm sure that I will run across someone that I met somewhere in my early travels. Maybe while I was playing baseball with them or met them at the dance that night after the baseball game. So all in all, it's helped everything that I could do to broaden my friendship in this world. That's what I'm trying to do.
